sample_video_frames: sample a single segment of fixed size frames from a video sequence with random or central offset
compute_audio_spectrogram: compute audio spectrograms from raw waveform including log mel filterbank and MFCC features
crop_and_resize_frames: crop video frames to a target height and width with optional random cropping or central crop
resample_audio_signal: resample raw audio signal from one sample rate to another using FFT-based resampling
apply_color_augmentation: apply standard color augmentation to video frames including brightness, saturation, contrast, and hue jitter
